android.desc:
Neil Young Archives is the first of its kind musicians’ archive where you can chronologically explore and enjoy Neil Young albums, tracks, movies, video, art and most everything about his creations.

This is the companion app to the website that brings Neil’s Hi-Res music  (up to 196/24) and videos to mobile devices.

NYA Classic members can chronologically explore all of Neil Young’s albums, using a detailed timeline, and play all his recordings in Hi-Res streaming audio from an Android phone or tablet.

Members have also access to an extensive video and movie archives of Neil’s videos and movies that users can watch on an Android phone or tablet for a modest cost.

SUBSCRIPTION & TERMS:

For non-NYA members, this app allows you to:
- Explore the Timeline
- Read Neil Young’s Times-Contrarian newspaper
- Listen to the song-of-the-day and one free featured album

An “NYA CLASSIC” subscription plan gives you access to:
- Complete Neil Young Hi-Res catalogue streaming on web, phone,  tablet, and Android Auto
- Pre-sale concert tickets for yearly subscribers - the best seats in the house (Yearly subscribers only)
- Exclusive live concert streams
- Hi-Res at Low-Res Prices. 
- Hi-Res track download from the NYA Download  store (powered by
Orastream), minimum 5 tracks per order
- NYA Times Contrarian Newspaper (new articles written by Neil and the
great team of NYA writers, updated regularly)
- Unreleased archival video content made available to you first
- Info cards for each song with lyrics, credits, photos, memorabilia, and
documents (Desktop Only)
- NYA Movie Night at the 3-screen Hearse Theater with exclusive screenings
- Pay per view access to extensive video and film archives
- Early discounts at the NYA Greedy Hand store / vinyl / CDs / files / swag
& more
- Browse the NYA File Cabinet and Info Cards with Lyrics and information
about all songs (Desktop Only)
- Browse the Timeline and see how it all happened and continues to grow
- Playlists

You can sign up for “NYA CLASSIC” for $24.99 a year which includes access to pre-sale tickets.

An “NYA RUST” subscription plan gives you access to everything offered in the CLASSIC subscription listed above….PLUS:

- Unlimited access to “MOVIETONE”, the  NYA video and film archive consisting of scores of music videos, long videos, and full-length movies.

- “TIMELINE CONCERTS” where members can make concert requests and listen to other members’ requested  live performances
